request.description:
### API Endpoint to retrieve all the employees with some information for each of them.

This endpoint retrieves comprehensive information regarding the system's employee directory.

You can paginate results using `limit` and `offset`. If `limit` is omitted, it defaults to 10. The maximum supported value for `limit` is 100. If `offset` is omitted, it defaults to 0.

In addition to pagination parameters, you can utilize filters to precisely retrieve the data you want. You can find suitable IDs for the current filters by accessing the 'directory filters' endpoint.

Optionally, you can request employee custom fields to be included in the response by providing the `custom_fields` query parameter as a comma-separated list of field slugs (from `GET {{baseUrl}}/custom-fields`). Standard/predefined field slugs are merged at the root of each row, while custom (non-predefined) field slugs are returned under the `custom_fields` array.

request.description:
API Endpoint to create an employee.

This API endpoint facilitates the creation of an employee within the system. When creating an employee, it's necessary to provide essential personal information such as first name, last name, and email address. Additionally, the endpoint requires details regarding the employee's hire date, employment status, and manager. When we are adding a new employee, we should avoid creating loops or circles in the organization hierarchy. If the `is_existing` parameter is set to true the onboarding process is bypassed. Otherwise, if it's set to false, the employee is considered a new hire, and the system initiates the onboarding process for the newly hired employee. In cases where no manager is specified, the employee becomes the head of the company hierarchy. You can choose to disable the initial system invite. In case you want to provide some additional information on onboarding new hires at the organization, you should fill in the hire packet object with the necessary information. This allow you to send an a email to the hiring employee containing detailed instructions for their first day of work. --- After the successful creation of a newly hired employee's profile, an email is dispatched to the new hire containing essential information required for registering with the domain. This includes details such as login credentials, and any other relevant information to facilitate their smooth integration into the company's systems. Additionally, emails are sent to existing employees who are assigned the responsibility of conducting the onboarding tasks for the new employee. --- **Request body:** | Name | Type | Required | Description | Values | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | first_name | string | true | Maximum character limit: 191 characters. | e.g. John | | last_name | string | true | Maximum character limit: 191 characters. | e.g. Doe | | email | string | true | It has to be valid email format and structure. Maximum character limit: 191 characters. The email has to be unique. | e.g. [john.doe@example.com](https://mailto:john.doe@example.com) | | hire_date | date | true | The hire date must be formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'. | e.g. 2024-01-10 | | reports_to_employee_id | integer | true | The employee Id that will be the manager of the current employee. If the reports_to_employee_id is 'null' then the current employee will be the head of the company. | \- | | employment_status | object | true | Object with properties: employment_status_id (integer). | e.g. {"employment_status_id": 1} | | job_record | object | false | Object with properties: job_title_id (integer,nullable), location_id (integer,nullable), division_id (integer,nullable), department_id (integer,nullable). All the variables must be present. | e.g. {"job_title_id": 1, "location_id": 12,
"division_id":null,
"department_id":20} | | compensation_record | object | false | Object with properties: pay_rate (integer), pay_rate_period (enum,nullable) \[hour, day, week, month, quarter, year\], pay_schedule (enum,nullable) \[once-per-month, twice-per-month, every-other-week\], overtime_status (enum,nullable) \[exempt, non-exempt\] | e.g. {"pay_rate": 1000, "pay_rate_period": "day", "pay_schedule":"once-per-month", "overtime_status":null} | | prevent_email | boolean | false | Opt for 'true', if you don't want to send an invitation email to the hiring employee, else 'false'. | \- | | is_existing | boolean | false | Opt for 'false' if the employee is a new hire and you want to run the Automatic Onboarding process, else 'true'. | \- | | hire_packet | object | false | Info for the new hire.Object with properties: who_id (integer, id of employees), address (string), when_time (date-time), instructions (string) | e.g. {"who-id":1, "address": "Random Str 123A", "when_time":"2024-03-10 17:00", "instructions": "These are some instructions..."} |

However, it is important to note that the availability of this feature is dependent on your TalentHR subscription (Refer to the Introductory chapter for further details). request.description:
API Endpoint to terminate the employment of an employee.

This API endpoint demonstrates the process of employee terminations within the HR system by incorporating the **effective date** of termination and the **reason** for termination. Users can remain active and utilize the system normally until the final termination date is specified. Upon the termination process, the system automatically assigns offboarding tasks to relevant users, ensuring a seamless transition for the terminated employee (employees are being notified also via email). If the termination date matches the current date, the user is instantly terminated, preventing further access to the system. When an employee is terminated, the system initiates several automatic procedures to ensure a smooth transition and maintain organizational integrity. Upon the employee's termination, employees who are under his/her supervision are reassigned to the manager of the terminated employee. Concurrently, any incomplete task assignments of the terminated employee are transferred to this manager as well. Furthermore, the system automatically deletes any job records, compensation records, manager records, or employment status records that are dated after the termination. Additionally, any time off requests(rejected or remain unanswered) from the terminated employee will be removed. Finally, if the terminated employee is part of a hiring team for a job position, he/she will be removed from the hiring team as part of the termination process. _**Note:**_ _The information of the terminated user remains within the system after the termination._ **Request body:** | Name | Type | Required | Description | Values | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | effective_date | date | true | The date that an employee will be terminated. The effective date must be formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'. | e.g. 2024-02-01 | | termination_reason | string | false | The reason for the employee's dismissal. Maximum character limit: 4000 characters. | e.g. poor quality of work | | termination_type | string | false | The type of termination. If omitted, it defaults to `termination`. | Available values: `termination`, `resignation` | | regrettable_status | string | false | Indicates whether the termination is regrettable. If the termination is not regrettable, omit this parameter or set it to `null`. | Available value: `regrettable` |

request.description:
### API Endpoint to get the Time Off budgets of an employee.

This endpoint returns the time-off budgets allocated for the specified employee across time-off cycles (historical cycles from the employee's hire context through cycles the product exposes).

Each row combines the **fixed** budget for a time-off type and cycle with **accrual aggregate** fields when the employee has accrual entitlement for that type and cycle:

- Fixed: `original_budget`, `budget`, `used_budget`
- Accrual aggregates: `employee_has_accrual`, `accrual_original_budget`, `accrual_budget`, `accrual_used_budget`, `accrual_carry_on_original_budget`, `accrual_carry_on_budget`, `accrual_carry_on_used_budget`
- Unlimited accrual usage (when applicable): `has_unlimited_timeoff`, `unlimited_used_budget`

Optional query parameters:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| time_off_cycle_id | integer | false | Limit results to a specific time-off cycle. |
| active | integer | false | When `1`, limit results to the currently active time-off cycle. |
